KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki.
